questions.text: Which of the following peaks is the highest in the Western Ghats?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Anamudi (2,695 m) is the only Western Ghats peak exceeding 2,600 m, while Doddabetta (2,637 m), Mullayanagiri (1,930 m) and Kalsubai (1,646 m) are lower; thus eliminate the three lower options. Detailed: Anamudi in Kerala is the highest point of the Western Ghats and of South India; Doddabetta is the highest in the Nilgiris but slightly lower; Mullayanagiri is the highest in Karnataka; Kalsubai is the highest in Maharashtra. Hence Anamudi is the correct answer.

questions.text: Identify the antonym of the word 'Audacious' from the options below.
questions.solution: 'Timid' means lacking courage or confidence, which is the direct opposite of 'audacious' (bold and daring). 'Daring', 'Bold', and 'Reckless' are all synonyms or near-synonyms of 'audacious'.

questions.text: Improve the bracketed part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' if the sentence is correct. [Walking down the street], the flowers smelled lovely.

options.label: A
options.text: Walking down the street, the flowers smelled lovely.

options.label: B
options.text: The flowers smelled lovely walking down the street.

options.label: C
options.text: As I walked down the street, the flowers smelled lovely.

options.label: D
options.text: Walking down the street, I smelled the lovely flowers.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Dangling Modifier Check. The introductory participial phrase 'Walking down the street' must logically modify the subject of the main clause. Flowers cannot walk. Eliminate options where 'flowers' is the subject (A, B). Option C corrects the clause structure but retains 'flowers' as subject of main clause (still illogical for the modifier). Option D supplies the correct subject 'I' for the action 'Walking'. Worked Solution: In (A) and (B), 'flowers' is the subject, creating a dangling modifier (flowers don't walk). In (C), 'As I walked...' is a dependent clause, but the main clause subject remains 'flowers', disconnecting the action from the smeller. In (D), 'I' is the subject of the main clause, correctly modified by 'Walking down the street'.

questions.text: As of early 2024, which of the following is the most recently notified Tiger Reserve in India (55th Tiger Reserve)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Arrange options chronologically by notification year: Ramgarh Vishdhari (2021, 52nd), Ranipur (2022, 53rd), Dholpur-Karauli (Aug 2023, 54th), Guru Ghasidas-Tamor Pingla (Nov 2023, 55th). The latest date wins. Full Solution: The 55th Tiger Reserve notified in Nov 2023 is Guru Ghasidas-Tamor Pingla in Chhattisgarh. Dholpur-Karauli (Rajasthan) was the 54th (Aug 2023). Ranipur (UP) was 53rd (2022). Ramgarh Vishdhari (Rajasthan) was 52nd (2021).

questions.text: The 'Mission Shakti' conducted by India in March 2019 demonstrated India's capability in which domain?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Keyword association. 'Mission Shakti' (March 2019) + 'Satellite' = ASAT. 'Mission Divyastra' (March 2024) = Agni-5 MIRV/ICBM tech. 'HSTDV' = Hypersonic. 'PDV/AD-1/AD-2' = ABM/Interceptor. The name 'Shakti' (Power) was specifically assigned to the ASAT test (Mission Shakti) where DRDO destroyed a live satellite (Microsat-R) in Low Earth Orbit. Full Solution: Mission Shakti was the code name for India's first successful Anti-Satellite (ASAT) missile test conducted on March 27, 2019. A DRDO Ballistic Missile Defence (BMD) interceptor (PDV Mk-II) successfully engaged and destroyed the Microsat-R satellite at an altitude of ~300 km in Low Earth Orbit (LEO), making India the 4th nation with demonstrated ASAT capability. It was not a Hypersonic, ICBM, or ABM target test (though it used BMD tech, the *demonstrated capability* was ASAT).

questions.text: Which of the following pairs of 'Mountain Pass – Connecting Regions' is INCORRECTLY matched?

options.label: B
options.text: Shipki La – Himachal Pradesh and Tibet

questions.solution: Shortcut: Lipulekh Pass is the gateway to Kailash-Mansarovar in Tibet (China), connecting Uttarakhand with the Tibetan plateau; it forms the India-China-Nepal trijunction but does not directly connect Uttarakhand to Nepal proper. Full Solution: Zojila connects Kashmir Valley (Srinagar) with Ladakh (Leh). Shipki La (Himachal) and Nathu La (Sikkim) are major trade passes to Tibet. Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand) opens into Tibet (China) for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra; the Kali River separates it from Nepal.

questions.text: Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph: P: The report highlighted the alarming rise in pollution levels. Q: Consequently, the government announced strict emission norms. R: Environmentalists have long warned about the health hazards of smog. S: The recent smog episode in the capital validated their concerns.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Find the opening sentence (general statement). R introduces 'Environmentalists' and 'warned'. S follows with 'validated their concerns' (pronoun 'their' links to Environmentalists). P provides specific data ('report highlighted'). Q concludes with action ('Consequently'). Sequence: R-S-P-Q. Full Solution: R sets the context (long-standing warnings). S provides the immediate trigger (recent smog validating warnings). P cites the official evidence (report on pollution rise). Q states the result (government action). 'Consequently' in Q confirms it is the final sentence.

questions.text: Which of the following is the longest river flowing entirely within Peninsular India?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Basin Area/Length ranking elimination. Godavari is the largest peninsular river system (length ~1465 km, basin ~3.12 lakh km²). Krishna (~1400 km) is second. Kaveri (~805 km) and Mahanadi (~858 km) are significantly shorter. 'Dakshin Ganga' epithet confirms Godavari's dominance. Worked Solution: The Godavari River rises at Trimbakeshwar (Maharashtra) and flows east for 1,465 km, draining the second-largest basin in India after the Ganga. The Krishna River is approx 1,400 km long. The Kaveri is approx 805 km. The Mahanadi is approx 858 km. Thus, Godavari is the longest peninsular river.

questions.text: Select the word most nearly similar in meaning to the word given in capital letters: EPHEMERAL
questions.solution: Shortcut: Antonym elimination. Three options (Eternal, Permanent, Enduring) are synonyms of each other meaning 'lasting forever'. Ephemeral means 'lasting for a very short time'. The odd one out matching this definition is Transient. Worked Solution: Ephemeral describes something short-lived (e.g., a mayfly). Transient means lasting only for a short time; impermanent. Eternal, Permanent, and Enduring are all antonyms of Ephemeral. Thus, Transient is the correct synonym.

questions.text: Rearrange the following sentences (P, Q, R, S) to form a coherent paragraph. P: Consequently, the groundwater levels have dropped alarmingly. Q: The region has received scanty rainfall for the third consecutive year. R: Farmers are now forced to dig deeper borewells for irrigation. S: This has led to a severe drought situation in the district.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Chronological/Logical Flow — Identify the Cause (Q) -> Immediate Effect (S) -> Secondary Effect (P) -> Human Response (R). Eliminate options starting with Effect (S) or breaking the Cause-Effect chain (Q-P skips the drought declaration). Worked Solution: Q states the root cause (scanty rainfall). S states the direct consequence (drought). P explains the environmental impact of the drought (groundwater drop). R describes the resultant human action (digging borewells). The correct sequence is Q-S-P-R.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of Magnetic Flux?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate options using quantity association. Tesla is the unit of Magnetic Flux Density (B), Henry is the unit of Inductance (L), and Coulomb is the unit of Electric Charge (Q). Magnetic Flux (Φ) is measured in Weber (Wb). Full Solution: Magnetic Flux is defined as the surface integral of the magnetic field (B) over a surface area (A). Since B is in Tesla (T) and A is in m², the unit is T·m², which is defined as 1 Weber (Wb).

questions.text: Deficiency of which vitamin causes Pellagra, classically characterized by the '3 Ds' – Dermatitis, Diarrhoea, and Dementia?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Mnemonic 'Pellagra = 3 Ds = Niacin (B3)'. Beriberi (B1) = Wet/Dry; Pernicious Anemia (B12) = Neuro/Megaloblastic; Scurvy (C) = Gums/Bleeding. Full Solution: Pellagra is caused by Niacin (Vitamin B3) deficiency (or tryptophan deficiency). The classic triad is Dermatitis (photosensitive), Diarrhoea, and Dementia; untreated leads to Death (4th D). Thiamine (B1) causes Beriberi. Cobalamin (B12) causes Megaloblastic anemia. Ascorbic Acid (C) causes Scurvy.

questions.text: Consider the following statements regarding the 'Kaziranga National Park': 1. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. 2. It is the single largest undisturbed habitat of the Indian One-Horned Rhinoceros. 3. It is located in the Karbi Anglong district of Assam. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Verify location/district knowledge to eliminate. Kaziranga is located in Golaghat and Nagaon districts (partly), not Karbi Anglong (Karbi Anglong hills are south of the park, distinct district). Statement 3 is incorrect. Eliminate Options B, C, D (all contain 3). Only Option A remains. Full Solution: Kaziranga National Park (Assam) was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985 (Statement 1 correct). It hosts ~2,400+ Indian One-Horned Rhinos, the largest population globally (Statement 2 correct). It is situated in the Golaghat and Nagaon districts. Karbi Anglong is a separate district to the south, known for the Karbi Anglong Hills which act as a refuge during floods, but the park itself is not *in* Karbi Anglong district (Statement 3 incorrect).

questions.text: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution are the Fundamental Duties of citizens enumerated?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the 'A' mnemonic — Fundamental Duties were Added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976 and placed in Article 51**A** (Part IVA). Eliminate Article 32 (Remedies), Article 45 (Directive Principle - Early Childhood Care), and Article 51 (Directive Principle - International Peace). Step-by-step: Fundamental Duties were inserted via the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee. They are listed in Part IVA under a single Article 51A.

questions.text: Which of the following is the highest peak of the Western Ghats?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Map-based elimination. Guru Shikhar is the highest in the Aravallis (Rajasthan). Doddabetta is the highest in the Nilgiris (Tamil Nadu). Kalsubai is the highest in Maharashtra (Sahyadris). Anamudi (2,695 m) in Kerala is the overall highest peak of the entire Western Ghats range. Step-by-step: The Western Ghats run north-south. Anamudi is located in the Anaimalai Hills (Kerala/Tamil Nadu border) and is the highest point in India south of the Himalayas. Doddabetta (2,637 m) is the second highest.
